description: This file defines a PHP class for interacting with SAPDB databases via ODBC, including methods for retrieving primary keys, indexes, columns, and server info. It extends the ADODB_odbc class, indicating it is a database driver implementation for SAPDB within the ADODB PHP library.

classes.name: ADODB_SAPDB
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADODB_odbc to implement SAPDB-specific database interactions including schema info and connection handling.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_sapdb
classes.description: A record set class for SAPDB queries, extending ADODBRecordSet_odbc.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description, parsing version from description if not provided.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Returns primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Returns index information for a table, optionally including primary key index info.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns detailed column information for a table, including data type, length, default value, and if it's a primary key.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Returns the list of column names for a table.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Fetches the current value of a sequence or similar identifier for a table.
